title: I Cannot Run the CLI Version
body:
- I am running the CLI version on both Windows and Linux, but I encounter the error shown below when attempting to launch it and cannot figure out how to fix it. Could someone guide me on how to run AIOZ DePin? root@LXC-1-130:~# ./aioz-depin-cli start --home depin-data --priv-key-file privkey.json
Error: failed to encrypt private key: keytool encrypt failed: exit status 1, stderr: Error: unknown flag: --password
Usage:
aioznode keytool encrypt [flags]

Flags:
-h, --help   help for encrypt

Global Flags:
--home string         directory for config and data (default "/root/.aiozworker")
--log_format string   logging format (json|plain) (default "plain")
--log_level string    logging level (trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|panic) (default "info")
--trace               print full stack trace on error


Usage:
aioz-depin start [flags]

Examples:

./aioz-depin start --priv-key-file privkey.json
./aioz-depin start --home /custom/path --priv-key-file privkey.json


Flags:
--auto-update            Auto-update on startup (experimental feature)
--disk-cap int           Maximum allocated disk capacity (in MB)
-h, --help                   help for start
--home string            Node root directory containing config and data (default "/root/.aioz-depin-cli")
--hub-address string     Custom hub address
--max-open uint          Maximum number of open connections (default 1000)
--priv-key-file string   Path to private key file
--read-timeout uint      RPC read timeout in seconds (default 3600)
--write-timeout uint     RPC write timeout in seconds (default 3600)

Global Flags:
--log-format string   For log format (json|plain) (default "plain")
--log-level string    Log level (trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|panic) (default "info")
--trace               Print full stack trace on error
